title: Petey Perfectpants and the Silly Sock Puppet Problem
author: Jimmy Vee
intro: Petey Perfectpants' spelling tests are flawless and his shoes are spotless, but he has trouble making friends.
checkedAgainst: Storyline Online page and teacher guide
Gary Wilkinson illustrator blog and reviews

questions.q: What is the main character's name?
questions.clue: His name rhymes with neat pants.

questions.q: What kind of test scores does Petey always get?
questions.clue: He never makes a mistake on tests.
questions.yes: Petey always gets flawless spelling tests.

questions.q: Why do other kids call him Petey Perfectpants?
questions.clue: They feel intimidated by his perfection.
questions.yes: Other kids call him Petey Perfectpants because he is too perfect.

questions.q: What does Petey try to make to get a friend?
questions.clue: He puts fabric on his hand.
questions.yes: Petey tries to make a sock puppet.

questions.q: How did Petey feel about his sock puppet at first?
questions.clue: He thought it looked too silly.
questions.yes: Petey felt his sock puppet was too silly.

questions.q: What does Petey do with the sock puppet initially?
questions.clue: He gets rid of it because it is silly.
questions.yes: Petey throws the sock puppet away.

questions.q: When does the sock puppet appear stuck to Petey's hand?
questions.clue: It happens after he wakes up.
questions.yes: The puppet appears stuck the next morning.

questions.q: What kind of personality does the sock puppet have?
questions.clue: It loves playing tricks and causing chaos.

questions.q: Where does the puppet cause lunchroom lunacy?
questions.clue: It happens during the school day.
questions.yes: The puppet causes lunacy at school.

questions.q: Who talks to Petey about the pranks around the school?
questions.clue: The head of the school speaks with him.
questions.yes: The principal talks to Petey about pranks.

questions.q: Why is Petey's perfect school day thrown into chaos?
questions.clue: The puppet refuses to behave properly.
questions.yes: The school day is ruined because the puppet causes trouble.

questions.q: What does Petey finally realize about his perfection?

options.text: It was part of his problem

questions.clue: His pursuit of perfection stopped him from connecting.
questions.yes: Petey realizes trying to be perfect was part of his problem.

questions.q: Why does embracing mistakes help Petey make friends?
questions.clue: Letting go of perfection opens doors to real connection.
questions.yes: Embracing mistakes helps Petey connect with other kids.

questions.q: What does Petey decide to embrace at the end?
questions.clue: He chooses not to be completely perfect anymore.
questions.yes: Petey decides to embrace being wonderfully weird.

questions.q: How does Petey feel when he finally makes real friends?
questions.clue: Finding real friendship brings joy and connection.
questions.yes: Petey felt happy when he made real friends.
